differentiators.observation: The sessions + streamed-actions composition that PRODUCT-BLOCKED the frozen 0102-epoch Snapback research-room arm (1 pass / 2 GAP / 12 fail: cold-start preflight refused bounded_response_stream_v1) now works end to end on the public packaged closure: the artifact admits on a sessions target, ctx.streamAttempt provides lease + crash-safe terminal-winner custody with effectMayHaveExecuted and idempotent rejoin, and ctx.fetchStream drains a real upstream with secrets staged server-side. The exact composition 0031 demanded as 'a CI sessions-plus-streamed-actions fixture' is externally reproduced by this arm.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: bounded_response_stream_v1 admission on sessions targets; the streamAttempt custody surface (lease, terminal winner, effectMayHaveExecuted, idempotent rejoin); staged secrets reaching the upstream and never any client-visible surface.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: evidence/probe-stream/*; scenario-evidence.json A5-12; diaries/0031 (Snapback product-blocked arm)

differentiators.observation: The AI-pipeline product shape needed no scheduler service and no external workflow engine: a serialized per-stage mutation (assistStep) makes naive fence logic correct, an action loop turns it into 4 separately committed durable progress updates with 35-85ms live observer deliveries, and the same in-transaction status check IS the cancellation fence. The frozen Convex arm needed scheduled mutations for the same durable-progress shape; SpacetimeDB/InstantDB could not express it at all.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Serialized commit order making read-check-write stage logic correct; live composition queries (question + progress + answer in one registered live query) delivering each commit to authorized subscribers.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: scenario-evidence.json A5-06/A5-08; diaries/0031 (Convex scheduled-mutation progress; InstantDB/SpacetimeDB gaps)

differentiators.observation: Cancellation fencing produced an auditable authoritative log, not just absence of damage: every late durable-patch lane (worker step, direct progress, answer commit, re-settle) was fenced AND receipted append-only in the attempt ledger, with the terminal record byte-stable — evidence quality beyond the frozen arms, where fencing was proven by absence only.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: In-transaction fences writing only fence receipts; append-only attempt ledgers surviving as authoritative history.

differentiators.observation: Secret custody is clean by construction where the frozen Convex arm had its Stop-class defect: no control credential in argv, loopback-bound local services, the canary secret absent from receipts, ledgers, tick responses, dev output, and all prior evidence, and config status reporting custody (set/secret) but never bytes — while the secret provably REACHED the external provider from the server (strict 401 provider).
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Value-free diagnostics and receipts; ctx.secrets staging with the redactor covering stream error envelopes; admin config custody reporting set/secret only.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: scenario-evidence.json A5-12 canarySecretScan; diaries/0031 (Convex argv/wildcard Stop)

differentiators.observation: Acceptance velocity: the full 13-check suite — fresh versioned-seed install, 8 sign-ins, two file uploads, a five-outcome fault matrix, live observer legs, scheduler ticks with real egress, and two receipted reset-installs — runs in 5.0s wall; the deterministic tick seam and the versioned-seed reset receipts made every scheduler and cleanup fact collectable without sleeping on cadences.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Machine-readable dev lifecycle; admin tick seam; receipted reset-install restoring the literal fixture including named-empty runtime tables.

differentiators.observation: Fixture-identity integrity guarded the arm's own evidence: changing seed bytes (JSON-text vector -> v.json array) under a reused seedVersion was refused by the SNAPBACK_SEED_VERSION_REUSED ledger with both digests named — the versioned-seed system treats seed identity as immutable evidence, which no frozen 0102 arm's backend offered.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The seed-version ledger refusing changed bytes under a reused identity.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: diaries/0046 (the .1 -> .2 bump); A4 capsule seedIdentity note (same behavior)
